reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so this is a real problem for me, and a named lab with a report for the batch is more than I get from most things on TikTok Shop. At $24.99 for the first box I'd try one, but not at $29.99.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I'm paying extra for a lab report I may never read.
would_change_my_mind: If it were $29.99 with no launch price, I'd probably pass and buy the cheaper one.
